scientific_integrity: Proof and finite numerical corroboration are distinguished. Prior general source-unfolding research acknowledged. Residual bibliographic uncertainty disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive right regular n-gonal pyramids, n>=3, sampled uniformly by total surface area. Inverse uses exact distribution and exact upper-tail coefficients. No claim of finite-sample estimation stability or of novelty of general Voronoi unfolding.
title: Apex distance tails reconstruct every right regular pyramid
